claim: Van Syckel Insurance, 11 E Union Ave, Bound Brook - listed as an independent agency (SuperPages source)
problem: Not independent any more. World Insurance Associates announced it acquired the business of Van Syckel Insurance effective 1 August 2025 and now serves clients from 300+ offices; the file's 'independent agency' evidence is stale and the listed phone 732-356-3200 does not appear in the current sources I saw (an older listing shows 908-281-0043). A branch of a national brokerage is an excluded type.
fix: Remove the entry, or relabel it as a World Insurance Associates branch and move it to the excluded list; update the phone/name if a current local contact can be confirmed.

claim: Green Brook Academy, 324 Talmage Ave, Bound Brook - private school
problem: This is a state-approved private special-education school serving middle- and high-school students referred by district child study teams. Schools are an excluded type, so the entry should not be in an independent-business list. Its own site also lists 151 Vosseller Ave with several nearby campus buildings, not 324 Talmage Ave.
fix: Remove the entry (schools excluded). If the buyer wants education-adjacent operators, keep it only in a clearly separate, labelled category.

claim: SCP Distributors LLC, 6 Easy St, Bound Brook - wholesale pool-supply distributor
problem: This is a branch warehouse/showroom of SCP Distributors, the national pool-supply distribution brand (listed on the NPT/SCP store locator as the Bound Brook branch). It is a chain branch, not an independent local business; the file itself flags it as borderline.
fix: Remove it from the independent list; the corporate branch will not buy local services the way an owner-run firm does.

claim: Coverage gap: CPA / accounting firms on E High St, Bound Brook
problem: Herbert M. Benton & Associates (305 E High St, Suite 2, 732-667-3416) and Joseph P. Vecchio Jr., CPA (305 E High St, 732-764-1600) both appear on the Bound Brook CPA / 08805 tax-prep lists I searched, but neither is in the file, even though three other 305 E High St tenants are listed.
fix: Add both firms (both look like small independent practices) after a quick confirmation call or a second source for each.

claim: Coverage gap: South Bound Brook landscaping / tree contractors
problem: My 'landscaping contractor South Bound Brook NJ' search surfaced Jose's Tree Service & Landscaping (South Bound Brook, per its Nextdoor business page) and Legendary Landscaping (listed under South Bound Brook on Yellow Pages). Neither is in the file; the file has only Clean Cut Landscape Services for that borough.
fix: Add both if an in-borough address can be confirmed; otherwise record them in data_gaps with the reason.

claim: Coverage gap: dentists and Main Street shops
problem: Urgent Care Dentistry appears in the DentistsRanked Bound Brook top-10 but is absent from the file (it may be a low-value listing - one review, no site). K Wireless (403 E Main St - phone/accessory sales and repair) is on the boundbrook.com directory I opened and is also absent.
fix: Add Urgent Care Dentistry only after confirming it is a distinct independent practice; add K Wireless as an independent phone-repair shop.

claim: Wallace M. Graves Associates (409 E Main St) and Raritan Dental Center (421 W Union Ave) cite boundbrooknj.net
problem: The cited boundbrooknj.net page opened as a generic 'add and claim your listing' shell with no business name, address, phone or category on it, so the address and 732-356-0272 phone cannot be substantiated from that source. Raritan Dental Center is still corroborated by the DentistsRanked page; Wallace M. Graves is not corroborated anywhere I opened.
fix: Re-source Wallace M. Graves Associates (county or state land-surveyor records, or a second directory) or downgrade it to address/phone Unknown. Drop boundbrooknj.net as a citation.

claim: Central NJ Structural Engineers, 369 Construction, Katamount Construction, Precision Building & Construction, Carter & Sons Roofing cite Google Maps search URLs
problem: A Google Maps search URL is not a per-business citation - it resolves to whatever the searcher's map view returns and cannot be re-opened as evidence for a specific name, address or phone.
fix: Replace with a directory page, own website, or licence/registry record per business; mark anything that cannot be re-sourced as unverified.

claim: Bound Brook NJ Locksmith, 427 W Union Ave, Bound Brook
problem: The site is a single-town, 24/7 mobile locksmith landing page that says it is 'based in Bound Brook' but publishes no shop address; 427 W Union Ave does not appear on any page I opened. Pattern is typical of lead-generation sites rather than a walk-in shop.
fix: Keep only as a mobile/service-area business with address set to Unknown, or verify the street address independently before it is used for outreach.

claim: Frank DeVito Law Firm, 409 E Main St
problem: Only one small attorney directory supports it (409 East Main St, 732-563-9864 per that listing). I could not confirm a current practice; the NJ judiciary disciplinary portal shows a 2006 record for a Frank D. DeVito, which does not by itself establish that he is the person listed or that the office is open.
fix: Verify against the NJ bar attorney search or drop; do not spend outreach time until confirmed.

claim: Sandoval Express Insurance, 409-B E Main St, phone Unknown
problem: Name and phone are incomplete/incorrect. Both the Progressive independent-agent page and the Yellow Pages listing call it 'Sandoval Express Services, LLC' and give 732-667-7218.
fix: Rename to Sandoval Express Services, LLC and add phone 732-667-7218.

claim: Blank website fields on several entries that have their own sites
problem: Official sites exist but were not captured: JDP Electric (jdpelectricnj.com), Frank Mineo Electrical (mineoelectric.com), Jeffrey Burke Plumbing (jeffburkeplumbing.com), Dr. Nicole Padovan (drnicolepadovan.com), Dr. Zora Stefanovski (dentistboundbrook.com, listed phone 732-356-0412).
fix: Backfill these website/phone fields; a website is the single best qualification signal for this outreach.
